name: write-xbrief
description: Write an xBRIEF spec and continue.json directly — without launching the interactive planning agent. The workspace copy lives in the runtime dir `.overdeck/`; finalize reads it and promotes the canonical spec to `.pan/specs/` in the project repo. Use when the work is well-understood and the agent can author the plan from the issue body and codebase alone. Also use when you ARE the work agent and need to self-plan before implementing. Covers the full xBRIEF v0.8 schema, continue.json format, task sizing rules, and the `pan plan finalize` handoff command.
